In Theorem 32, we give CNF formulas which have polynomial size tree-like OBDD(∧, reordering) proofs but require exponential size for tree-like OBDD(∧, weakening) proofs. A summary of the (non-)simulation results for dag-like systems is shown in Figure 1. There are still a few questions left open about the systems shown there. First, it is a long-standing open problem whether CP∗ simulates CP. Second, it is open whether OBDD(∧, weakening) simulates CP. Third, we do not know whether resolution is simulated by OBDD(∧, reordering). In fact, we do not know whether resolution is simulated by OBDD(∧). A couple of earlier papers have claimed that resolution is not simulated by OBDD(∧), see Theorem 5 of [21] and Corollary 4 of [12], but we have been unable to verify their proofs.1
